title: Story premise ENT099: The Queue Number on the Wrong Side
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: My ticket seems very abstract. Takeaway/theme: An error can reveal where the interface needs a clearer cue.
description: A customer wants to know when their turn arrives but keeps watching the decorative back of a ticket. Nearby numbers advance until they rotate the ticket, discover theirs was just called, and politely show the attendant; the attendant flips a sample ticket above the counter for the next confused customer.
